name: OpenCodeInterpreter
abstract: OpenCodeInterpreter closes the loop between writing code and running it: models generate, execute, and refine code using execution results and feedback, trained on the Code-Feedback corpus of multi-turn interactions. Results on this page will be populated at the next TokenWave data refresh.
contributions: Integrates code generation with execution and iterative refinement instead of one-shot output.
Releases Code-Feedback, a 68K multi-turn dataset of code, execution results, and human feedback.
Shows that execution-driven refinement substantially narrows the gap to proprietary code-interpreter systems.
method: Each turn the model proposes code, observes execution output, and revises until the task passes or budget runs out.
Training data mixes single-turn packing, execution-feedback traces, and human-feedback corrections.
Evaluation uses standard code-generation suites with and without refinement rounds.
